method: Avoided burden: emissions avoided by replacing virgin plastic production with mechanical recycling
formula: CO2e saved (kg) = mass recycled (kg) x (EF_virgin - EF_recycled)
source: RecycleMeter factor set: average LCA emission factors for mechanical recycling versus virgin petrochemical synthesis
